items.question: Which Vedic authorities are invoked in relation to the classification of ritual fire?
premises: Vyāsa is named as an authority.
Bodhāyana is named as an authority.
Āpastamba and Āśvalāyana are also named as authorities.
items.inference: These named Vedic teachers are cited as authorities relevant to the stated position on ritual fire.
uncertainties: The specific action attributed to these authorities is supplied by the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Vyāsa, Bodhāyana, Āpastamba, and indeed Āśvalāyana.
